letters.title: Congratulations!
letters.text: I was amazed by the sheer amount of details in this creation. Looking forward to extra additions in this cozy little room.

letters.title: Letter #1: the box is open
letters.text:
Hi Sina,

This is the first letter to drop through the slot. If you're reading it, the door opened, the card held, and the mailbox actually works.

Keep it here as a reminder of the day the room went live.

Next visitor: your turn. Say hi, ask something, or just leave your name.

— Sina, Nov 2026
